featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are looking for a fitness center that balances a professional environment with a welcoming community feel, I will surely recommend Flex Iron Gym (Vikhroli West).

Standout points are:
1. Expert and Friendly Staff: One of the highlights of this gym is the staff. Trainer Sukanya, in particular has a very friendly nature and approachable attitude. Having a trainer who is supportive makes a huge difference, especially on days when your motivation is low.

2. Well-Equipped Facilities: The gym is stocked with high-quality, well-maintained machines. Whether you are focused on heavy strength training or functional movements, you’ll find the right tools for your workout.

3. Fair Cardio Policy: To ensure every member gets a fair chance to work on their heart health, the gym has a 15-minute limit on cardio machines during peak times. This helps every member to get a fair chance to do their cardio.

4. Gym Vibe: The gym maintains a high standard of hygiene and has a high-energy vibe that keeps you focused on your goals.

featured_reviews.name: Anj Illustrator
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this gym recently after a long break, and the experience was disappointing. There was no receptionist, and the system was not working. Instead of handling this professionally, the coach Sukanya assumed I did not have a valid membership and asked for a screenshot of my payment. Even after I showed the bill, she said that my admission was taken by another trainer (Ashwini) and that she needed to “cross-check,” which felt like poor internal coordination and unnecessary doubt placed on the member.

As someone returning after a break, I expected at least basic guidance or a welcoming attitude, but the behavior was rude and unprofessional.

I was doing cardio on the treadmill, and although no one was waiting to use it, I was asked to step down immediately after 15 minutes, without any flexibility and in a very rude manner.

Overall, the environment feels uncomfortable, and the trainers seem focused mainly on personal training. Members who don’t opt for PT are not treated well. Due to similar behavior, my sister shifted from this women’s gym to a unisex gym, where professionalism and member treatment are much better.

I was planning to extend my membership, but after this experience, I won’t be doing so. I hope the management improves staff coordination, professionalism, and customer handling.

featured_reviews.name: Kareeshma W
featured_reviews.review_text:
Completely personalized training and what phenomenal value for money. Highly recommended for anyone looking to achieve their goals NOT by any shortcuts, but pure sheer dedication.

Mehul had come highly recommended, but I was initially hesitant based on the pricing. I booked myself a 3month training with him as a birthday gift to myself. In the first month itself, I could see what I was paying for, and have continued with him after that.
One of the most systematic trainers I have met, with such in depth knowledge of everything including nutrition. He has a modification for every feedback on muscle discomfort. He gave me minimal tweaks in my nutrition which significantly dropped my weight. But most of all, he brought what I had never achieved in my whole life- good , healthy muscle definition !
I have trained since many years, but with weight training under his guidance I have been able to achieve the muscle definition I have never had in my entire life !
It's a completely no- nonsense gym. I enjoy it because there's no wasting time, no waiting in line for machines like in crowded gyms, there's no random exercises, and you're constantly tracking and becoming a better version of yourself since the previous session.

featured_reviews.name: Srushti
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined Mehul’s fitness studio mainly for nutrition guidance with a fat loss goal, and the approach was very different from what I had tried before. Mehul didn’t put me on extreme diets or food restrictions. He first understood my lifestyle, eating habits, and daily routine, and then created a nutrition plan that was practical and easy to follow. It felt realistic, not forced, which helped me stay consistent.

Over time, I started noticing steady fat loss along with better energy levels and improved digestion. The biggest change was how my relationship with food improved, I learned what to eat, when to eat, and why it works. Mehul’s clear explanations and constant support made the journey sustainable. I’d definitely recommend him to anyone looking for long-term fat loss through proper nutrition rather than quick fixes.

featured_reviews.name: Gaurang Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today completes one full year of my journey. I have moved from 91 kg to 76.6 kg, losing 14.4 kg—but this transformation is about much more than numbers on a scale.

I want to say this from the bottom of my heart: thank you. Your guidance, encouragement, and belief in me came at times when I needed it the most. Without your support, I honestly don’t think I would have reached this stage.

This journey tested my patience, discipline, and mindset, and you stood by me through it. You helped me believe that change was possible, even when it felt difficult.

What you do genuinely impacts lives, including mine. I truly believe that such selfless good work never goes unrewarded, and may karma bless you and your family abundantly for all the positive change you bring to others.

I will always be grateful for your role in my journey. Thank you for everything.

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Todi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been training with Mehul for over 6 months now at Svasti and here are my quick takeaways -

1) This is the longest I’ve lasted at one place so definitely doing something right

2) Most of my apprehensions around strength training were unfounded and it’s been an absolute revelation. It gives you a an instant high and the next minute humbles you as well making you not just improve your health but teaches valuable lessons

3) Having the right personal trainer can make a world of a difference to your fitness and that’s where Mehul stands apart from everyone else. His focus and dedication to his craft is easily visible in the way he understands your capability and customises his plan for you (personally seen improvements in my posture and reduction in chronic back pain after he proactively started focusing on my back)

4) I’ve gone from a mindset of ‘lift-more-every-time’ to ‘step back and focus on your form’ thanks to him which has allowed me to lift more over time

5) Your body will always respond to effort, be it slow or fast and all you need to contribute is consistency

Investing my time at Svasti with Mehul continues to pay off multifold in the form of improved health - both physical and mental.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dropped in here last week. Pros: It’s a decent space. Front desk staff were helpful and friendly. Clean.

Cons: They need more squat racks. Some of the equipment is strange and the numbers do not correspond to the correct weights.

**MOST importantly, this gym has the problem that many Indian gyms have: male trainers who need to re-learn how to interact with women. I was benching alone and while I was doing my very light warmup weight, a trainer came up behind me and reached to spot me without asking. I was NOWHERE close to failing, nor was I in danger. Spotting someone on bench press means, to put it crudely, hanging your crotch over their face, and potentially touching their chest/breast if you do need to help. I am simply stunned that anyone would think it’s appropriate to come so close to me without seeking consent. Mere minutes later, another trainer approached me when I was in the middle of a rep on a machine to try to talk to me. Anyone who has ever been to a gym understands that you DO NOT speak to someone when they are in the middle of a rep. It is dangerous. I have been weightlifting for 11 years and do not need help from these men; if I need help, I will ask. (Fun fact: the guy who seemed poised to correct me was later spotted giving genuinely awful advice to someone else on how to perform a squat, so I didn’t want his help anyway.) I would strongly suggest to I think fitness a new set of protocols so their trainers do not behave this way in the future.

Congratulations, Thanekars! It seems we've got a new lounge/dance bar after the closure of the Secret and MH04—and it's located right opposite the closed location hence maybe they want to give that feel (see attached video).

With Gold's Gym located barely 100 meters away, I would strongly recommend exploring that option if your goal is serious fitness training and a peaceful workout environment.

I am trying to get my first unassisted pull up, and I joined Fitoholic Raw Fitness Studio (Manpada) with that goal in mind, apart from regaining flexibility. Hopefully by the end of the year I will be able to update this part of my review in past tense.

Space/Ambience/Equipment: The gym is spacious and can accommodate a lot of people and works well for group classes as well as special ones at the same time. Though primarily a calisthenics gym there are many traditional strength training equipment that one can make use of.

Trainers: All the coaches right from the trainees to senior most levels are well aware of proper professional ethics and standards of coaching, and are effective mentors for aspiring calisthenic athletes. In my experience of 2 months I found it a safe space for all genders, ages, and skill levels. Upon going to the gym, you will be evaluated by a unique scoring method to determine your current fitness level. You will also be evaluated every month therefrom upon joining which allows you to gain a statistical insight into your progress.

Fees: Competitive and fair pricing.

Overall: Highly recommended if yoga, flexibility, and calisthenics are your goals.
